course.name: Medicine and Surgery, MBBS
course.notes: Standard A100 MBBS route at Preston. The published North West Home residency/Foundation Entry restriction is intentionally not evaluated in ApplySmart for this profile; all UK applicants use the existing Home applicant group. The separate international Foundation Entry route is outside this A100 profile.

medical_school.name: School of Medicine and Dentistry, University of Lancashire

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Home/UK applicants follow the generic Home pathway. UCAT is required, but the 1750 value is stored only as ApplySmart working historical guidance, not as an official University of Lancashire cut-off.
International applicants are assessed through the existing International group and do not require UCAT.

overall_policy.description: ApplySmart checks the measurable GCSE, A-level/IB/international/graduate academic requirements and Home UCAT requirement. It does not model regional Home residency or UCLan Foundation Entry status by product-scope decision.
not_eligible_if: Supported academic requirements are not met.
A Home/UK applicant has not supplied a UCAT score for the current application cycle.
A-levels are flagged as not taken in one sitting.

gcse.notes: The broader statement about sustained Science, English and Maths study to age 16 is documented but not converted into a numeric GCSE score.

standard_offer.notes: AAA including Chemistry plus one further science subject. All A-levels must be taken in one sitting.

a_level.notes: The current generic profile does not collect one-sitting evidence unless the applicant flags resits; resit flags are treated as not meeting the one-sitting requirement.

grade_requirements.notes: IB 36 overall with HL Chemistry and a second HL science at grade 6 is represented for International applicants and any applicant using IB.

degree_requirement.subject_requirement: Science/Health degree, or another subject with BBB at A-level including two sciences with Chemistry.

degree.notes: The generic evaluator can check the 2:1 classification, GCSE Maths/English and Home UCAT. Degree subject and alternate BBB science evidence remain documented boundaries.

international_qualification.notes: International qualifications are assessed by the university against the published 144 UCAS Tariff/equivalence benchmark. ApplySmart only accepts applicant-supplied institution-verified equivalence.

post_16.notes: Supported automatic routes are A-level, IB, institution-verified international qualification and the representable part of the graduate route.

ucat.threshold_basis: ApplySmart working historical guidance only, not an official University of Lancashire cut-off.
ucat.notes: UCAT is required for UK/Home applicants. International applicants are exempt. No official minimum UCAT cut-off or weighting is published.

sjt.notes: No official SJT policy was located.

resits.conditions: UCAS specifies that all A-levels must be taken in one sitting. ApplySmart does not infer a broader resit policy.

english_language.notes: UCAS and the university course page disagree on the IELTS overall requirement. ApplySmart records the discrepancy and does not enforce a definitive IELTS rule until resolved.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Professional checks are informational course requirements and are not used for interview prediction.

ranking_factors.notes: An academic score is referenced but no executable scoring formula is published.
UCAT is used as part of selection before interview for UK applicants, but no official cut-off or weighting is published.
ApplySmart cannot objectively score this component.
ApplySmart cannot objectively score reference or panel-review components.

total_score.notes: No numeric academic/UCAT/personal-statement/reference weighting model is published.

calculation.notes: No ApplySmart interview probability or interview-likelihood band is calculated.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: ApplySmart checks measurable academic requirements and Home UCAT guidance only. It does not estimate interview likelihood.

adjustments.value: Up to 8 UCAS Tariff points for eligible Medicine applicants.

contextual_admissions.notes: Contextual policy is documented for eligibility transparency but not used to create an interview prediction or lower UCAT guidance threshold.

ranking_pools.name: Home A100 applicants
ranking_pools.notes: ApplySmart does not estimate this holistic shortlisting process.

ranking_pools.name: International A100 applicants
ranking_pools.notes: International applicants do not require UCAT.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.
Official published Home/UK intake places for the 2027-entry A100 admissions cycle. Informational only; not used for eligibility, interview prediction or applicant ranking.
Official published International intake places for the 2027-entry A100 admissions cycle. Informational only; not used for eligibility, interview prediction or applicant ranking.

standard_offer.a_level: AAA including Chemistry plus one further science subject

offer_selection.contextual_offer: Fair Access Scheme may reduce Medicine offers by up to 8 UCAS Tariff points, with subject requirements still applying.
offer_selection.notes: Offer prediction is out of scope.

historical_admissions.notes: Third-party UCAT figures informed ApplySmart's internal working threshold but are not university-published and are not displayed as official cut-offs.

Official UCAT cut-off is not published.
Academic scoring formula is not published.
Personal reflective statement and reference weighting is not published.

validation.review_notes: Safe for production eligibility-only assessment. Interview prediction remains disabled.

engine_assumptions: All UK applicants use the existing Home applicant group; North West residency and UCLan Foundation Entry status are not collected or evaluated.
1750 is ApplySmart working historical guidance only, not an official University of Lancashire cut-off.
International applicants do not require UCAT.
IELTS is recorded as an unresolved official-source discrepancy and is not enforced automatically.
do_not_infer: Do not implement North West residency or Foundation Entry evidence gates.
Do not label 1750 as an official UCAT minimum.
Do not produce Strong, Realistic, High Risk or Interview Likely bands.
Do not infer SJT use or weighting.
